title: Customer-Pay Repairs Rate Card: Labor, Refinish, Paint Materials, Dent and Minimum Charges
content:
**Crestline Collision & Glass - Customer-Pay Repairs rate card.** The figures below are the per-tier rates at which a Customer-Pay Repairs quote is priced from the written estimate. Each Customer-Pay Repairs repair order is held under exactly one service tier, and every rate on the order is read from that tier's column.

## Rates by service tier (USD)

| Service tier | Body labor rate (per hour) | Refinish labor rate (per hour) | Paint and materials (per refinish labor hour) | First dent, without paint | Each further dent, same visit | Minimum job charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 85.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 95.00 | 45.00 | 95.00 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 58.00 | 62.00 | 38.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 125.00 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 62.00 | 62.00 | 42.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 225.00 |
| Panel Repair Service | 62.00 | 62.00 | 42.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 350.00 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 64.00 | 64.00 | 44.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 |
| Complete Refinish Service | 66.00 | 68.00 | 48.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2500.00 |

## What each column means

- **Body labor rate**: Body labor rate (USD per hour).
- **Refinish labor rate**: Refinish labor rate (USD per hour; 0.00 means no refinish).
- **Paint and materials**: Paint and materials charge per refinish labor hour (USD per hour).
- **First dent, without paint**: Price of the first dent repaired without paint (USD; 0.00 means not applicable).
- **Each further dent, same visit**: Price of each further dent on the same visit (USD; 0.00 means not applicable).
- **Minimum job charge**: Minimum charge for the quoted work (USD).

## Reading the card

- A 0.00 refinish labor rate marks a tier with no refinish: on the card that is the Paintless Dent Repair Service, which also carries 0.00 for paint and materials.
- A 0.00 dent price means the dent prices are not applicable to that tier. Only the Paintless Dent Repair Service carries dent prices: 95.00 for the first dent and 45.00 for each further dent on the same visit.
- Body labor and refinish labor are separate rates. Within Cosmetic Touch-Up Service, for instance, an hour of body labor is 58.00 while an hour of refinish labor is 62.00 and also draws 38.00 of paint and materials.
- Bumper Refinish Service and Panel Repair Service share their three hourly rates (62.00, 62.00, 42.00) and differ in their minimum job charge (225.00 against 350.00).

## Rate look-ups (hypothetical hours, for illustration only)

| Tier | Hypothetical quoted hours | Reading from the card |
|---|---|---|
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 1.0 hour of refinish labor | 64.00 of refinish labor and 44.00 of paint and materials |
| Complete Refinish Service | 1.0 hour of body labor | 66.00 of body labor |
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 1.0 hour of body labor | 85.00 of body labor |
